mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the water return was most worthwhile: it made the separation loop concrete and showed how reaction water goes back through treatment and electrolysis.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the separator first produced no partners, so it offered little guidance beyond showing that preparation was needed.

surprise.text: The reactor inspection automatically used the unpurified test cylinder, then established a continuing clean methane outlet.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt wholly purposeless, though the separator's initial empty compatibility list did not explain what preparation it needed.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the purified fuel supports the return and the core's journey, particularly because the separate cooling, gas and water paths made the plant physically intelligible.
